## generateUniqueIdent() function

A generated custom property name.

Generated names are stable for a given generator namespace and source namespace so that separate builds produce the same output. They are also recognisable, so that generated properties are never processed a second time.

Callers may append another custom property name to the result, which keeps the result a valid custom property name.

**Signature:**

```typescript
export declare function generateUniqueIdent(generatorNamespace: string, sourceNamespace: string, increment: string): string;
```
